details.name: Description
details.value:
You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams. The team ships weekly and keeps a short list of priorities that everyone can read. You will write clear requirements, review designs with engineers and check the result against the goal.

  • You will own the roadmap for a small internal platform used by several operations teams.
  • Most of the work is turning vague requests into scoped, testable changes.
